query: Our Express server uses the openai npm package with OPENAI_API_KEY. Switch it to Phaseo without rewriting our calls.
expected_behavior: Keeps the OpenAI SDK and changes only apiKey to process.env.PHASEO_API_KEY and baseURL to https://api.phaseo.app/v1
Checks each model ID against GET /v1/models and maps unprefixed names such as gpt-4.1-mini to Phaseo IDs instead of guessing
Smoke tests with phaseo/free, including one streaming request
Does not print or commit an API key

query: Move this Python service from api.anthropic.com to Phaseo. It uses anthropic.Anthropic() and client.messages.create.
expected_behavior: Points the Anthropic client at the root host https://api.phaseo.app, not https://api.phaseo.app/v1, because the SDK appends /v1/messages
Passes PHASEO_API_KEY as a bearer token (auth_token) and reads it from os.environ
Keeps messages and max_tokens in the request body
Reviews anthropic-beta headers instead of carrying them forward

query: We proxy OpenAI through oai.helicone.ai with Helicone-Auth, Helicone-Property-Team and Helicone-User-Id headers. Move us to Phaseo and keep the per-team cost breakdown.
expected_behavior: Removes Helicone-Auth and the Helicone base URL
Maps Helicone-Property-* to X-Phaseo-Metadata labels and Helicone-User-Id to the user field or X-Phaseo-User-Id
Lists Helicone features with no direct equivalent instead of inventing headers
Plans the observability cutover before switching traffic

query: Replace our LiteLLM proxy with Phaseo. The config.yaml has model_list aliases, router_settings fallbacks and a Langfuse success_callback.
expected_behavior: Maps each model_list alias to a Phaseo model ID verified with GET /v1/models, a preset, or one boundary map
Maps router_settings fallbacks to the models array or dynamic routes
Gives the callback an explicit replacement (observability destination or client-side tracing)
Mentions the option to keep LiteLLM and use Phaseo as its upstream with openai/<model ID>

query: This Next.js app calls generateText with model strings like "openai/gpt-4.1-mini" through Vercel AI Gateway and AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY. Move it to Phaseo.
expected_behavior: Installs @phaseo/ai-sdk-provider matching the installed ai major version and wraps model IDs with phaseo(...)
Notes that bare string model IDs keep routing through Vercel's gateway until replaced
Sets PHASEO_API_KEY in every runtime that held the gateway key

query: Start a new FastAPI app that calls Phaseo for chat completions. There is no existing AI code.
expected_behavior: Uses phaseo-gateway or phaseo-sdk-python instead of the migration workflow

query: We already use Phaseo. Help me upgrade our prompts from one Claude model to a newer one.
expected_behavior: Treats this as a model change on Phaseo, not a platform migration
